name: 10456 · Bronx, NY
findings: ZIP 10456 (Bronx) has 211 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10456 (Bronx) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10456 (Bronx) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
